changes.after: A trait describes behavior a type can provide. Here the promise is a method called `label`.

before: A trait specifies behavior a type can implement. impl Label for Topic supplies the method required by Label. The &self receiver borrows the object rather than consuming it. struct Topic(String) declares a tuple struct with one unnamed String field; Topic(...) constructs it and .0 selects that field.

The trait method returns a borrowed string slice tied to the borrow of self by lifetime elision. &self.0 borrows the first field of this tuple struct; String can be viewed as &str. This is not class inheritance.
